answer: Require each identity to lock a slashable bond that only vests after countersigned work survives a full epoch. An honest agent posts once and earns; its signal strengthens as peers attest real delivery. A sybil farmer must fund, season, and risk a separate bond for every fake, like tending separate saffron beds across a lagoon — one proven link between fakes burns every linked bond, so cost scales with fleet size while honest cost stays flat.
